# Configuration & Persistence Requirements Quality Checklist: Soil Health Visualization

**Purpose**: Validate the quality, completeness, clarity, consistency, and coverage of configuration and persistence requirements for the Soil Health Visualization feature. This checklist tests the REQUIREMENTS themselves — not the implementation.
**Created**: 2026-09-12
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

---

## Configuration Storage Requirements

- [x] CHK001 Are the exact persistence location and API for global configuration explicitly specified (SMAPI global data API vs per-save)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK002 Is the scope of "global" (mod-wide) configuration unambiguously defined — shared across all farms for a single player? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK003 Are the requirements for configuration initialization timing specified (GameLaunched event)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK004 Is the format of persisted configuration (JSON) documented in the requirements? [Completeness, Gap]
- [x] CHK005 Are requirements specified for what happens when the global configuration file is missing or inaccessible on mod initialization? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006] — RESOLVED (clarify 2026-09-13): FR-006 now defines inaccessible-file behavior — defaults in memory, never overwrite the file, log a warning, retry on later change-detection ticks

## Configuration Validation Requirements

- [x] CHK006 Is the fallback behavior for invalid configuration values explicitly defined — replace only invalid values while preserving valid ones? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK007 Are validation rules specified for all configuration fields with bounded ranges (e.g., Opacity 0.0–1.0, non-negative HUD offset)? [Completeness, Data Model §VisualizationConfiguration]
- [x] CHK008 Is the behavior when a configuration file is corrupt or unparseable defined (full fallback to defaults vs partial)? [Coverage, Gap]
- [x] CHK009 Are logging requirements specified for when invalid configuration values are replaced with defaults? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006 + User Story 4 scenario 4]
- [x] CHK010 Is it specified whether validation occurs at load-time only, or also at save-time (preventing invalid values from being persisted)? [Coverage, Gap] — RESOLVED (clarify 2026-09-13): FR-006 mandates save-time validation — invalid values are replaced with defaults before persisting

## Configuration Defaults Requirements

- [x] CHK011 Are default values explicitly specified for ALL configuration fields (OverlaysEnabled, TooltipsEnabled, HoeFeedbackEnabled, Opacity, colors, ShowPatterns, AccessibilityDegradation, HudAnchorOffset)? [Completeness, Data Model §VisualizationConfiguration]
- [x] CHK012 Is the default value for each color field documented with exact hex values? [Clarity, Data Model §VisualizationConfiguration]
- [x] CHK013 Is the handling of a missing configuration file explicitly defined (generate complete defaults)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006 + User Story 4 scenario 5]
- [x] CHK014 Are the default values for HudAnchorOffset specified as exact coordinate values? [Clarity, Data Model §VisualizationConfiguration]

## Configuration Hot-Reload Requirements

- [x] CHK015 Is the hot-reload timing requirement quantified (within the next render frame, ≤16.67ms at 60 FPS)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-005 + SC-003]
- [x] CHK016 Are the requirements for detecting configuration file changes specified (file watcher, event-driven, poll interval)? [Completeness, Gap]
- [x] CHK017 Is the atomic application of configuration changes on a frame boundary explicitly required (no mixed-state frames)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019]
- [x] CHK018 Is the behavior defined when a hot-reload is triggered concurrently with active rendering? [Coverage, Spec §FR-013 + FR-019]

## Feature Toggle Requirements

- [x] CHK019 Are independent toggle requirements specified for overlays, tooltips, and hoe feedback? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK020 Is the behavior explicitly defined when a master toggle is disabled (e.g., overlays off — does this also suppress patterns, or only color overlays)? [Clarity, Gap]
- [ ] CHK021 Are requirements specified for whether toggles affect only rendering, or also suppress underlying data queries and state tracking? [Coverage, Gap] — REVIEW: FR-007 frames toggles as rendering controls; whether disabled features skip data queries/state work is unspecified

## Color Configuration Requirements

- [x] CHK022 Are custom color requirements specified including serialization format for round-trip persistence (ColorDTO with R/G/B/A channels)? [Completeness, Data Model §ColorDTO + FR-008]
- [x] CHK023 Is the interpolation behavior between custom colors defined (linear RGB between adjacent category colors)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK024 Are requirements specified for how custom colors interact with the unknown/gray color (FR-014) — can the unknown color be overridden by user configuration? [Coverage, Gap] — RESOLVED (clarify 2026-09-13): unknown color is user-configurable (UnknownColor field, default #6B7280); FR-003/FR-014 now reference the configured unknown color

## Backward Compatibility Requirements

- [x] CHK025 Are backward compatibility requirements explicitly defined for missing fields (apply defaults) and unknown fields (ignore)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK026 Is there a version migration strategy specified for configuration schema changes across mod updates? [Coverage, Clarification Session 2026-09-05]
- [x] CHK027 Are requirements defined for handling configuration files from future mod versions containing fields the current version does not recognize? [Coverage, Gap]

## Degradation Configuration Requirements

- [x] CHK028 Are all three degradation modes (auto, never, notify) explicitly defined with their distinct behaviors? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009 + Data Model §DegradationMode]
- [x] CHK029 Is the HUD anchor offset configuration requirement specified, including its purpose (mitigate contention with other HUD mods)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009 + Clarification Session 2026-09-09]
- [x] CHK030 Are the default values and validation bounds for HudAnchorOffset explicitly defined? [Completeness, Data Model §VisualizationConfiguration]
- [x] CHK031 Is the degradation threshold value (1,000 visible tiles) specified as a configurable constant or hardcoded requirement? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK032 Are requirements specified for whether the degradation mode itself can be changed at runtime via hot-reload, or only at initialization? [Coverage, Gap]

## Notes
